scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:mobile
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:server:coverage && npm run test:mobile:coverage
scripts.build:web: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && npm --prefix mobile run export:web'
scripts.deploy:production: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && npm run typecheck && npm run build-app && npx vercel deploy --prod'
scripts.verify:quick: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web
scripts.verify:pr: npm run verify:quick && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run build:web
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:flows
scripts.app: bash -c 'source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && npm --prefix mobile start'
scripts.app:web: bash -c 'source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && npm --prefix mobile run web'
scripts.jira:whoami: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && node scripts/jira.mjs whoami'
scripts.jira:projects: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && node scripts/jira.mjs projects'
scripts.jira:create: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && node scripts/jira.mjs create -- "$@"' --
scripts.jira:comment: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && node scripts/jira.mjs comment -- "$@"' --
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts && cp prisma/dev.db prisma/demo.db && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL="${VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL:+https://$VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL}" npm --prefix mobile run export:web && npx esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=api/handler.cjs --packages=external
